inShort: B serves, A returns and runs in, and B drives the third ball at a target: into A's path to the net, or the middle.
rules: B serves from the baseline. A returns calmly to the middle of B's court, then runs to the kitchen line.

Put two cones on A's side, both halfway between the baseline and the kitchen line: one straight in front of where A returns from, one on the centre line. The first marks where A will be running when the drive arrives.
B calls the target before the serve, then drives the third ball there.
After each drive, A says "attackable" or "I had time".
Turn the shoulders as one block, chest toward the sideline, and meet the ball out in front.
5 drives per target, then switch target. After 10 drives, swap roles.
tooEasy: B no longer calls the target and picks it from where A is and how fast A moves.
tooHard: Drive at one target only, and A walks in slowly.
goodLooksLike: The drive arrives low at A's feet while A is still moving, and A has to hit up.
